summary: Honor sole material-only diagnostic without delivery

delivery.outcome: Return mutation-free no-change for synchronized legacy default branches with only an existing modified ticket index; preserve index bytes and staging.
nonGoals: No changes to Koru configuration or staged user data
No implicit release or change of delivery mode

architecture.decision: When the managed gate reports only GOV-MATERIAL-001 for the existing ticket index, verify its structured report and synchronized default HEAD before emitting no-change. All other diagnostics still fail.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded preflight change; existing late test/commit gates remain.

validation.evidence: Focused regression suite, full Python tests, managed gate and Docker validation
